tasks.desc: when it was last worked on
the reminders of it put off in a row
how pressing its deadline is, with the work left: 240 minutes of it a day

srcs.expr: 0 if me.deadline is None else 1 if me.deadline <= time else min(1, max(1440 / (1440 + me.deadline - time), me.left / 240 * 1440 / (me.deadline - time)))

tasks.desc: how long since it was last worked on: a week is 1

srcs.expr: min(1, (time - (me.created_at if me.last_worked is None else me.last_worked)) / 10080)

tasks.desc: how far into its estimate: past it, 0

srcs.expr: me.spent / me.estimate if me.spent < me.estimate else 0

tasks.desc: put off lately: three in a row is 1

srcs.expr: 0 if me.last_put_off is None or time - me.last_put_off >= 1440 else min(1, me.put_offs / 3)

tasks.desc: how much a task weighs: the weightiest first
done away from the computer: never the one to start now
until when it isn't reminded of
its score, if it's one to start now: not away

srcs.expr: None if me.away or not me.ready else me.score

tasks.desc: its score, if it's one to remind of: due soon, or stuck, and not resting

srcs.expr: None if not me.ready or me.rests_until is not None and me.rests_until > time else me.score if me.spent >= 2 * me.estimate or me.deadline is not None and (me.deadline - time + daytime) // 1440 <= 2 else None

tasks.desc: when it was done or dropped, as of its last change (minutes since 1970; none: open)

groups.desc: whether any of its tasks can be started now

srcs.expr: max(where(work.tasks.start, work.tasks.group, me.id)) is not None

groups.desc: when it was done or dropped, as of its last change (minutes since 1970; none: open)
